chapter.heading: Genesis 49
Jacob Blesses His Sons
chapter.v: Then Jacob called his sons and said , “ Gather yourselves together , that I may tell you what shall happen to youin days to come .
listen to Israel your father .
preeminent in dignity and preeminent in power .
then you defiled it — he went up to my couch !
weaponsof violence are their swords .
and in their willfulness theyhamstrung oxen .
and scatter them in Israel .
your father’s sons shall bow down before you .
and as a lioness ; who dares rouse him ?
and to him shall be the obedience of the peoples .
and his vesture in the blood of grapes .
and his teeth whiter than milk .
and his border shall be at Sidon .
crouching between the sheepfolds .
andbecame a servant at forced labor .
as one of the tribes of Israel .
so that his rider falls backward .
Iwait for your salvation , O Lord .
but he shall raid at their heels .
and he shall yield royal delicacies .
that bears beautiful fawns .
his branches run over the wall .
shot at him , and harassed him severely ,
( from there isthe Shepherd ,the Stone of Israel ) ,
blessings of the breasts and of the womb .
and on the brow of him who was set apart from his brothers .
and at eveningdividing the spoil . ”
All these are the twelve tribes of Israel . This is what their father said to them as he blessed them , blessing each with the blessing suitable to him .
Then he commanded them and said to them , “ I am to begathered to my people ;bury me with my fathersin the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite ,
in the cave that is in the field at Machpelah , to the east of Mamre , in the land of Canaan ,which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite to possess as a burying place .
There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife . Therethey buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife , and there I buried Leah —
the field and the cave that is in it were bought from the Hittites . ”
When Jacob finished commanding his sons , he drew up his feet into the bed and breathed his last andwas gathered to his people .

footnotes.footnote: 49:10 By a slight revocalization; a slight emendation yields (compare Septuagint, Syriac, Targum) *until he comes to whom it belongs*; Hebrew *until Shiloh comes*, or *until he comes to Shiloh*
49:19 *Gad* sounds like the Hebrew for *raiders* and *raid*
49:21 Or *he gives beautiful words*, or *that bears fawns of the fold*
49:22 Or *Joseph is a wild donkey, a wild donkey beside a spring, his wild colts beside the wall*
49:24 Or *by the name of the Shepherd*
49:26 A slight emendation yields (compare Septuagint) *the blessings of the eternal mountains, the bounties of the everlasting hills*
